title: The Harness
subtitle: Building the Enterprise AI Operating System
description: A 6-part series on harness engineering, company context, enterprise AI transformation, and developer enablement. Each episode pulls real, current case studies from Stripe, Notion, Block, Cisco, Shopify, Atlassian, and others to show how leading companies are building the scaffolding that turns AI models into trusted enterprise systems.
author: Priya Anand & Marcus Hale
